recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If the hosted comparison endpoint itself returns runtime errors or needs better missing-page handling, treat that as comparison-service or publisher infrastructure follow-up rather than a Base type source-text correction.
issue_request: FHIR-41288 reported that Compare to R4/R4B links at the bottom of the Base page could fail for prior-version types.html pages because Base was added in R5. Jira status is Applied with Persuasive resolution; the resolution says the issue is not a specification issue and was already fixed by hosting the W3C comparison service directly in HL7.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-41288 was found. Source history shows implicit application in the generated footer template: 79c1d3ae328738b78f62d3644395f0dafe6ed7b1 removed the W3C htmldiff URL for the then-current comparison link, and 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 later changed the footer to use https://www.fhir.org/perl/htmldiff.pl for Compare to R4, Compare to R5, and Compare to Last Ballot.
additional_context: The active source/fhir.ini type-page mapping places Base on types.html, and tools/templates/newfooter.html is generated page chrome. FHIR-I minutes on 2026-01-12 record that FHIR-41288 predated Grahame's fix and was addressed via hosting the W3C comparison service; minutes on 2026-04-13 record the final Persuasive 13-0-0 approval. A related Applied issue, FHIR-46684, concerns similar Compare to R5 service behavior but was not decided here.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current footer source no longer references services.w3.org and already points comparison links at the HL7-hosted fhir.org diff endpoint described by Jira and FHIR-I minutes.
